t: A local desktop app that runs chat, image, and speech models on your own computer.
steps: Find the Off Grid AI download for your operating system.
Ask IT to approve the install.
Check the computer has enough RAM or GPU for the models you want.
Install the app and download a small model from the catalog.
Turn off analytics in the settings if you want no reports sent.
Go offline and test a short chat.
Leave the local API endpoint off unless a project needs it.
